query: 八年级期中数学各班平均分是多少？输出班级名称、平均分，按原始满分计，排除缺考。

SELECT
  c.class_name AS "班级",
  ROUND(AVG(er.score), 2) AS "平均分"
FROM exam_results er
JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id
JOIN classes c ON e.class_id = c.class_id
JOIN exams ex ON er.exam_id = ex.exam_id
JOIN subjects s ON ex.subject_id = s.subject_id

  AND ex.exam_type = 'midterm'
  AND s.subject_name = '数学'

query: 八年级各班数学从期中到期末平均原始分提高了多少？输出班级名称、期中平均分、期末平均分、提升分数；各次考试分别排除缺考。

SELECT
  c.class_name AS "班级名称",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN e.exam_type = 'midterm' THEN er.score END), 2) AS "期中平均分",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN e.exam_type = 'final' THEN er.score END), 2) AS "期末平均分",
  ROUND(
    AVG(CASE WHEN e.exam_type = 'final' THEN er.score END) - 
    AVG(CASE WHEN e.exam_type = 'midterm' THEN er.score END), 
    2
  ) AS "提升分数"
FROM exam_results er
JOIN exams e ON er.exam_id = e.exam_id
JOIN enrollments en ON er.enrollment_id = en.enrollment_id
JOIN classes c ON en.class_id = c.class_id
WHERE e.grade = 8
  AND e.subject_id = 'MAT'
  AND e.exam_type IN ('midterm', 'final')
  AND er.exam_status = 'attended'
GROUP BY c.class_name
ORDER BY c.class_name
